Ready for a new challenge in logistics? Become part of a world-class team at Valeo, the global leader in automotive parts. We’re looking for motivated full-time logistics professionals to join our dynamic facility in Helmond. If you speak English and have experience with order picking, this is your chance!

What are you going to do?
Join the team and help ensure smooth and accurate order processing!

- Order Picking: Use an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT) and hand scanner to pick orders accurately and report discrepancies.
- Packing: Pack products with care, using the correct boxes and labels to ensure safe and timely delivery.
- Continuous Improvement: Contribute to projects that enhance safety, efficiency, and overall performance.

Your schedule:

Monday to Friday, two shifts:

- Morning: 06:00 – 14:00
- Afternoon: 14:00 – 22:00

Accommodation is not included.

What do we offer?
In addition to a gross hourly wage of €16,10 bruto per hour (with 7% shift allowance) that will be paid weekly, we offer:

- 25% overtime allowance and even 50% on Saturdays;
- Travel allowance will be € 0,25 per km (0-35 kilometer single trip);
- Quarterly bonus opportunities;
- 8.33% holiday allowance & 25 days of leave (full-time basis);
- Possibility of a permanent contract and skill development.

Where will you work?
﻿You will be working at Valeo, a manufacturer of car parts. Parts such as clutch plates, windshield wipers and ignition locks are transported throughout Europe from the location in Helmond. The company is easy to reach by car and is located in the lively Eindhoven region. Parking is free. There is a good atmosphere within the company and fun activities are often organized, such as an annual family day. During your break you can enjoy free coffee, tea or soup.

What do we ask?
- You speak and understand English;
- You have experience as an order picker using a hand scanner and EPT;
- You’re safety-conscious and ready to work in a fast-paced environment.

Are you interested?

Do you have logistics experience and a technical mindset? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you! This is a full-time position (40 hours per week), mainly from Monday to Friday. Occasionally, you may work evening or weekend shifts, so flexibility is important.

In this role, you will be responsible for receiving, inspecting, processing, and preparing a wide variety of goods for shipment. You will work with high-value and time-critical shipments where accuracy, quality, and a structured approach are essential. Thanks to the diverse range of tasks and products, no two days are ever the same.

As a warehouse operator, you and your colleagues will ensure the warehouse operates efficiently. You will receive and process incoming goods, pick orders, prepare shipments for dispatch, and carefully pack, label, and inspect products. You will also manage packaging materials, maintain a clean and organized warehouse, and assist with the storage of sensitive goods, including medical products. In addition, you will install computers for new employees and help resolve minor technical issues.

- Must have lived in Europe for at least 8 consecutive years (required for a security screening VGB)
- 1 - 2 years of experience in a logistics or warehouse environment
- You are available to work morning and evening shifts during peak periods, including weekends.
- Good command of either Dutch or English
- Technical aptitude and basic computer skills

As a Forklift Operator in Eindhoven, you work full-time in two shifts: from 15:30 to 00:00 and from 22:00 to 06:30. This job is physically demanding and perfect if you like to stay active. You get attractive shift allowances, so your salary increases significantly during night and Saturday shifts.
On a typical workday, you are responsible for safely moving goods within the warehouse. You load and unload trucks, sort packages, and make sure everything ends up in the right place. Thanks to your efforts, the logistics process runs smoothly, even when it's busy. You work together with colleagues in a dynamic team.
Do you have a forklift certificate and are you looking for a long-term job? Apply quickly! This is your chance for a stable, well-paid job with opportunities for growth. 🚀

- You have a valid forklift certificate

- You are physically fit and have no problem with heavy work

- You speak and understand Dutch or English

- You are available full-time and want to work in 2 shifts

- You have your own transport, as the location is not accessible by public transport during night shifts

- You have a vmbo, havo, vwo, mbo or hbo diploma

- Experience as a forklift driver is a plus, but not required

Are you a fresh fruit saver, a milk situation solver, or a chips emergency helper? As a delivery driver at Albert Heijn, you’re all of them!  😎  You’ll earn a great salary of € 18,83 per hour after 13 weeks and enjoy a flexible schedule, working 2 to 5 days a week. 🤩 Curious about what else is in store for you?
